name: Horsens
subtitle: Horsens
_note: The wind-sector bearings and maximums are broad FRANK area estimates, not current club-published rules. They are off by default. The optional rule treats 45-135 degrees as easterly onshore wind over the longer fjord fetch and 225-315 degrees as westerly offshore wind, with maximums of 8.0 and 7.0 m/s respectively.

name: Vejle
subtitle: Vejle
_note: Coordinate 55.705, 9.68 is a mid-fjord forecast point whose complete DKSS position series has been verified end to end; nearby geometric grid nodes may still be masked, so the returned DMI cell is recorded separately for operator review. The optional 45-135 and 225-315 degree sectors and their 8.0 and 7.0 m/s maximums are broad FRANK area estimates, not current club-published limits, and are off by default. Brejning Baad Klub's public 29 June 2022 safety rules publish no numeric wind caps or compass sectors. An older 2016 document used 5, 6, and 8 m/s in separate guest, release-test, and instructed-introduction contexts, not as one safety ladder. Current rules: https://brejninghavn.dk/wp-content/uploads/bsk-pdf-manager/2022/10/Kajak-sikkerhedsbestemmelser-29-6-2022.pdf

name: Kolding
subtitle: Kolding
_note: Coordinate 55.512, 9.659 is the fjord-mouth point by Løverodde and Lillebælt. Its complete DKSS position series has been verified end to end; the visually attractive mid-fjord alternatives near 9.55 and 9.60 hit masked DKSS cells. The point is at the edge of Kolding Kajak Klub's stated daily paddling water. The club's published 5 m/s rule applies to non-released paddlers in a restricted area; it does not publish the 45-135 and 225-315 degree sectors or the 8.0 and 7.0 m/s maximums. Those sectors and maximums are optional FRANK area estimates and are off by default. Club source: https://koldingkajakklub.dk/sikkerhed

name: Aarhus S
subtitle: Aarhus S
_note: Coordinate 56.129, 10.257 is the southern Aarhus forecast point just off the city. Its complete DKSS position series has been verified end to end, and waves use DMI's finer WAM-DW grid. The city is on the west shore and the bay opens east and southeast toward Kattegat. The optional rule therefore treats 45-135 degrees as onshore and 225-315 degrees as offshore. The 8.0 and 7.0 m/s maximums are broad FRANK area estimates, not Aarhus club-published limits, and are off by default.

windSectors.description: Offshore wind (fralandsvind) from the city shore — capped lower for drift risk

name: Aarhus N
subtitle: Aarhus N
_note: Coordinate 56.1899, 10.2543 is the northern Aarhus forecast point off the Risskov coast. Water uses DKSS-NSBS because the finer IDW grid is masked here; waves use DMI's finer WAM-DW grid. The returned DMI cells are recorded separately for operator review and never change a verdict by themselves. The optional 45-135 and 225-315 degree sectors and their 8.0 and 7.0 m/s maximums are broad FRANK area estimates, not Aarhus club-published limits, and are off by default.
